title: Hyper-Realistic Editorial Photography
description: Crisp editorial fashion and documentary photography styling with genuine biological pore textures, cloth micro-weave, uncompressed tonal dynamics, and authentic color balance.

title: Cinematic 35mm Film Still (Kodak Portra)
description: Cinema motion picture still characterized by soft highlight rolloff, warm amber skin tones, subtle organic halation around bright light sources, and delicate film grain.

title: Classical Oil Painting (Impasto & Chiaroscuro)
description: Baroque and Renaissance oil painting traditions with visible brushstroke impasto textures, varnished oil sheen, rich earthy pigments, and deep theatrical illumination.

title: Futuristic Sci-Fi Concept Art
description: Sleek industrial design, hard-surface matte polycarbonates, glowing luminescent telemetry panels, holographic displays, and atmospheric planetary vistas.

title: Minimalist Fine Art Photography
description: Sparse visual geometry, expansive negative space, monochromatic or restrained palette, high graphic clarity, and serene contemplative subject arrangement.
